kicker: e-means, k-means with a moving average

scenes.text: Every IVF index in FAISS starts as 25 full passes of k-means. What if two or three were enough?
scenes.say: Every IVF index in FAISS starts as twenty-five full passes of k-means. What if two or three were enough?

scenes.headline: How e-means beats k-means in a tenth of the epochs
scenes.sub: Mini-batches, a moving average, and two fitted laws
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Wrenly! This is e-means, from Meta FAIR, now in FAISS. Let's see why it needs so few passes.

scenes.title: The cost of being exact
scenes.sub: Lloyd's algorithm, and where it stalls
scenes.say: Chapter one. The cost of being exact.

steps.say: Lloyd's algorithm alternates two exact moves. Assign every point to its nearest centroid.

steps.term: Centroid: the mean of a cluster's points
steps.say: Then move each centroid to the mean of its points.
One update per full pass. The FAISS default is twenty-five passes, so twenty-five centroid moves.
And since the loss only goes down, a bad start never gets fixed. It gets polished.

scenes.credit: the authors' toy, from the lead author's post

steps.say: The authors' toy shows it. Each centroid jumps all the way to its cluster's mean.
By iteration twenty-five, two centroids share a blob, and one is stranded between two.

scenes.title: Forget at a fixed rate
scenes.sub: A moving average where Lloyd keeps an exact mean
scenes.say: Chapter two. Forget at a fixed rate.

left.title: Running sum
items: Add every batch's sum and count forever
Step shrinks as one over N
left.say: Mini-batch k-means adds every batch to a running sum forever. Its step shrinks fast, and it never forgets.

right.title: Moving average
items: Fade the old sum and count
Same fixed rate for every batch
right.say: So it stalls above Lloyd. e-means fades old statistics at a fixed rate instead.

scenes.text: Keep a moving average of each cluster's count and sum, take many small steps per pass, and let fitted laws pick the batch and step.
scenes.mark: moving average of each cluster's count and sum
scenes.say: Here's the idea. A moving average of each cluster's count and sum, many small steps per pass, and fitted laws for batch and step.

scenes.title: The update, rewritten as a step

parts.note: toward this batch's mean of the cluster
parts.say: Rewritten, the update is a move toward the cluster's mean in this batch.
How far depends on the step, and on this batch's count over the faded count. A cluster that suddenly gets many points moves a lot.
parts.note: batch count over the faded count
a blend of old and new: never overshoots
parts.say: The weight is between zero and one, so it never overshoots.

parts.note: batch = all data, step 1: one Lloyd iteration
parts.say: Make the batch the whole dataset, with a step of one, and this is one Lloyd iteration. Lloyd is a corner of this family.

steps.say: One update: draw a mini-batch, assign it, sum per cluster.
Fold the sums into the moving averages, and the centroids follow.

steps.term: Cosine schedule: big steps early, small late
steps.say: The step anneals on a cosine, down to a tenth of its peak.
Every five updates, a starving cluster is rebuilt by splitting a busy donor.

steps.note: last epoch: centroids set to exact means
steps.say: In the last epoch, each centroid is set to the exact mean of its points.

params.left: Lloyd: one exact move per pass

steps.say: Let's race them on a toy. Five blobs, and one bad start: two centroids in one blob, one stranded between two others.
Lloyd moves every centroid all the way to its cluster's mean, every pass. It converges fast, and stays stuck.
e-means draws small batches. Each centroid steps part of the way toward its batch mean. The noise pulls the crowded pair apart, and a centroid finds the empty blob.

steps.term: Mini-batch: a small random sample of the points
steps.say: Same points, same start. Many small noisy steps found what one exact step could not.

scenes.title: Dead clusters on DEEP, 1M points
scenes.say: The split matters. With no revival, four thousand three hundred and thirteen clusters die. With the split, forty-seven.

scenes.title: No sweep required
scenes.sub: Two power laws choose the batch and the step

steps.say: A method that needs a sweep has lost to Lloyd already. Left: for each batch size, the best step, the stars, moves right as the batch grows.

steps.term: Knee: where a bigger batch starts to cost
steps.say: Right: loss is flat across batch sizes, until a knee.
Both are fitted as power laws, on about seventy-five thousand runs.

scenes.title: The laws at one million points

steps.say: Take the paper's ablation setting: a million points, three epochs.
The batch law gives sixty-five thousand five hundred and thirty-six.
The step law, zero point three six one.
That is forty-eight updates. Lloyd makes three.
About four points per cluster per update, against Lloyd's sixty-one. Sixteen noisy moves per pass, against one exact one.

scenes.title: Does it hold up?
scenes.sub: The paper's epochs and wall-clock, table by table
scenes.say: Chapter four. Does it hold up?

steps.say: Loss against epochs, where one is Lloyd at twenty-five. Blue, e-means, drops below the line within a few epochs.
The orange mini-batch baselines flatten above it. Across the main table, e-means needs one point four to two point six epochs.
In GPU wall-clock time, the paper reports nine point five times faster at worst.
And up to forty-five point five times at a billion points.
Above ten million there is an extra factor the epochs don't explain, and the paper doesn't break it down.

scenes.title: Where the claims get thinner
scenes.say: Three things are smaller than the headline.

items.text: Quality gain: fractions of a percent
items.say: The loss gain is fractions of a percent. The story is compute.

items.text: Seeded Lloyd falls only at 5 epochs
items.say: Against well-seeded Lloyd, it wins every case only at five epochs.

items.text: The laws were fitted on embeddings
items.say: And the laws were fitted on high-dimensional embeddings.

scenes.text: Lloyd was the costliest corner of a bigger family. Many small, scheduled, noisy steps get there in a tenth of the passes.
scenes.mark: costliest corner of a bigger family
scenes.say: Lloyd was the costliest corner of a bigger family. Many small, noisy, scheduled steps get there in a tenth of the passes.

recap: A moving average of counts and sums
Cosine step, split the starving clusters
Fitted laws pick the batch and step
scenes.say: To recap. A moving average, a cosine step, a split for the starving, and fitted laws. Thanks for watching!
